_comment: Change set 3 (attribution) — Step 0 findings and predictions, committed before any attribution code was written. Ranges are wide on purpose: they were set before a single label existed. Run under the user's instruction to proceed through every stop-gate without waiting for approval; every value here is PROVISIONAL — not ratified.

step0.selfCitationSignal: src/engine/signals/corporate.js selfCitationDominance: counts SELF_REF matches (our data|our study|our analysis|our research|our results|our survey|our internal …|we found|we measured|we surveyed|company data) anywhere in the raw document, against citations of type url/doi/author-year/numeric/year; fires when self >= external. Shows the first 4 spans while counting all (Fixture C: 5 counted, 4 shown). Identifies the publisher not at all — any first-person method phrase counts.
step0.profileCount: src/engine/profile/provenance.js selfCitationShare: share of reference entries + claim URLs whose text names an org token. Org tokens (orgTokens): the host's registrable label (>= 3 chars, not co/com/org/ac/edu/gov) plus any 'Pew Research Center', '<Name> Research Institute' or 'Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health' anywhere in the body. Read by DocumentProfile.jsx and scoreDocument (penalty share x 1.5 when pool >= 5).
step0.designDetection: src/engine/profile/design.js profileDesign: per sentence of the body, a sentence matching OTHER_WORK (author-year, [n], et al., superscript-style) counts as a citation to other work and is skipped; otherwise a design cue counts only if OWN_STUDY_FRAME matches (we|our|this study|… |participants|respondents|researchers|… surveyed). firstPerson (we|our in a cue sentence) decides inherited for derivative provenance. Identifies the publisher not at all.
publisherIdentificationIssues: Fixture A (CADRE, Building Brains Coalition): org token is 'Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health' — a school the report cites, not its publisher (no source URL; the regex takes any mention in the body).
Fixture C (Gensler): org token 'Gensler Research Institute' — correct; no host (PDF upload).
step0.knownGoodRegressionString: checks/regression-baseline.mjs FIXTURE is invented marketing text, which conflicts with ground rule 3 (real documents only). It is kept as the existing regression guard the handoff names, not extended, and the conflict is reported.

flagCounts._basis: Attribution adds a label and an explanation field; it does not touch tier, rung or the mismatch rule. Design detection changes only for sentences attributed own-current (they bypass the other-work exclusion and the frame requirement), which on these fixtures already frame their own study.

profileSelfCitation._basis: The unified counter keeps the profile's pool (reference entries + claim URLs) and its publisher match, so the profile numbers do not move; the signal now reads the same numbers.

score._basis: C loses a 0.4 note penalty but sits at the floor (raw -0.31 -> 0.09, both clamp to 1). A and B lose nothing.

predictions.registerMismatch: unchanged on all three (its inputs, tier and rung, do not change)
predictions.fixtureCOldSpans: all 5 sentences carrying the old signal's spans are labeled own-current; none counts as self-citation

labelDistribution._basis: Share of extracted claims per label. Guesses from reading the three documents, before any code ran.
